transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the weekly power-support meeting. We've got four facilities that need power units for the coming week — the clinic, communications shelter, battery shop, and refrigerated storage area — and four units on the board: P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4, all listed as serviceable and available. Before I finalize the allocation and sign the support plan, I'd like each of you to review your areas. Let's start with the power representative — what's the status on all four units?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, during yesterday's electrical inspection I confirmed that P-2 is the only unit with the recently certified isolated-output transformer required by the clinic's sensitive diagnostic equipment. The certification entry is still pending on the base inventory board, so P-2 still shows as just 'serviceable' alongside the others, but it needs to go to the clinic.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag something for the communications shelter. I confirmed this morning that the comm shelter's equipment requires regulated 28-volt output, which only P-4 provides. The updated compatibility note hasn't been added to the signal support annex yet, so it's not reflected on the board — but P-4 must go to the communications shelter.
